description: A React component named SettingItemMax for rendering configurable setting items with form controls, including handling submission, focus management, and error display.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calling the provided submit function with the current setting.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Sets up keydown event listener for handling Enter key presses and manages focus on mount.

methods.name: handleUpdateSection
methods.description: Calls updateSection callback with current section when cancel button is clicked.
